# Mr Egyptian

## About
Official website for the Mr Egyptian developer and the RubyT application.

## Application
RubyT is a lightweight and customizable AI-focused browser that provides access to AI tools and online services through organized categories.

## Developer
Name: Mr Egyptian

## Application Version
1V

## Main Website
The website provides information about RubyT, its current version, features, and download availability.

## Important
The application is currently experimental and may contain technical issues. Future versions are expected to improve and fix these issues.
